title: Design: Make Default confirmation looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop is about to make Net 30 the default, and you compare the confirmation with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is active and is not the default.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p1-09-make-net-30-the-default.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the Net 30 row.
  2. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window opens in the middle of the dimmed page (as in ct-p1-09-make-net-30-the-default.png): the title "Make Net 30 the default?" with a close × at the right, a line under the title, the message "New customers start on Net 30. Customers you already have keep their current term.", and at the bottom right "Cancel" (white, grey border) then "Make Default" (blue). The window is narrower and its corners less rounded than the New Credit Term window. The Cancel button's style and the × colour: this attribute depends on question 12 (drawn pictures or build pictures, not answered yet): for now compare it with the picture named here.
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R5: “"Make Default for New Customers" opens a confirmation titled "Make {name} the default?" with the message "New customers start on {name}. Customers you already have keep their current term." and the buttons "Cancel" and "Make Default".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Make Default chosen | "Make {name} the default?" / "New customers start on {name}. Customers you already have keep their current term." | Confirmation, buttons "Cancel" and "Make Default"”
